_comment: Sound ids and the files behind them. Ids are authored first and paths filled in
later: AudioDirector treats an empty path as 'this sound has no file yet' and
returns silently, so every call site can be written now and becomes audible the
moment a file lands here. Nothing needs changing in code to add a sound.
Paths are res:// paths to .ogg or .wav. A missing file warns once at load,
